title: Gemini Notebook Slide Decks and Videos

activities.title: Quick check: a claim that is not in the report

blocks.prompt: Gemini Notebook made a slide saying the drop in hard-to-find memos was "driven directly" by the naming rule. Your report only gives the numbers. What do you do?
options: Keep it. The AI read the whole report
Revise that slide so it says only what the report says
Delete the whole deck and type it again by hand
Present it, and say it was made by AI

activities.title: Module 4 Quiz: Presentations
activities.intro: 10 items, 1 point each. Pick the one best answer for each item. Everything on it was covered in Topics 4.1 to 4.7.

blocks.prompt: 1. Before you open the app, which three questions do you answer first?
options: How many slides, pictures and minutes

blocks.prompt: 2. "Use the same colours, fonts and title position on every slide." Which design principle is this?
3. About how big should body text and bullets be?
4. In PowerPoint, which key starts the slide show from the slide you are on?
5. You share your deck as a PDF. What stops working?
6. Which alt text is most helpful for a chart?
options: Bar chart of 8 office supplies by total cost. Bond paper is the biggest cost.

blocks.prompt: 7. Which picture is safest to use in an office deck?
options: A photo you took yourself, with permission from the people in it
A scene from a movie poster
A logo copied from another office's page

blocks.prompt: 8. Which motion is the best choice for an office report?
options: A different transition on every slide
One subtle transition, like Fade, on every slide
Animate every title, photo and line

blocks.prompt: 9. Your deck with an embedded video is too big to email (Gmail stops at 25 MB). What do you do?
options: Compress the media, or share a Drive link

blocks.prompt: 10. A bar chart's axis starts at 6,000 instead of 0. What is wrong with it?
options: It makes a small difference look huge
